description: A lore-grounded fantasy forge hall for Sangree, homeland of the Sanguire of Sandrun in Tunya. Obsidian-spire architecture: a low monumental black volcanic-stone forge house with a tall tapered chimney, heavy arched entry, ember-lattice metal braces, smelt-rune relief bands, broad fire-bloodline hearth opening, quench-vat alcove, and a signed-blade workbench bay. Built as a believable playable hero building with grounded walls, readable doors, thick masonry, asymmetrical hand-forged metal details, warm interior emissive fire surfaces, and weathered ash, soot, and red-orange metal accents. No characters.
